data.taskBrief:
TASK BRIEF: Submit a document for electronic signature (Zoho Sign API)

FIT
  Fully. The supplied request submits an existing Zoho Sign document to its recipients for signature. No requests are irrelevant.

AUTH
  OAuth 2.0 access token in the Authorization header: `Authorization: Zoho-oauthtoken <ACCESS_TOKEN>`. The collection indicates the token is added to the header using `{{ACCESS_TOKEN}}`.

BASE URL
  https://sign.zoho.com

STEPS
  1. POST /api/v1/requests/{Request_Id}/submit
     Params:
       Request_Id: string — the Zoho Sign document request ID, for example `2385687500987112`; place it in the path.
       data: URL-encoded string containing JSON — for example `{"requests":{"actions":[{"verify_recipient":false,"action_id":"238568888765470","action_type":"SIGN","private_notes":"Sign the doc","signing_order":0,"fields":[{"field_type_name":"Email","field_category":"textfield","field_label":"Email","is_mandatory":true,"page_no":0,"document_id":"2385687500987112","field_name":"Email","y_coord":51,"x_coord":53,"abs_width":16,"abs_height":2,"action_id":"238568888765470"}]}]}}`; place it in the `data` form field. The request schema marks this field optional, but use it when supplying action or field configuration.
     Returns:
       200 OK; the saved response has an empty body.
     Threading:
       None

GOTCHAS
  - Send the body as URL-encoded form data, not a JSON request body; put the JSON configuration inside the `data` field.
  - Replace `{Request_Id}` with the existing document request ID. The request does not create a document or produce an ID.
  - The example action uses `action_type` `SIGN` and includes an action ID and document field configuration; use IDs belonging to the document being submitted.
  - The collection variable resolves `{{SIGN_URL}}` to `https://sign.zoho.com`; the request-level Authorization header is disabled, so configure the collection OAuth authentication or send the equivalent Authorization header explicitly.
